استبحن (form X)
# اِسْتَبَحْنَ (istabaḥna) /is.ta.baħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَبَاحَ (istabāḥa)
# اُسْتُبِحْنَ (ustubiḥna) /us.tu.biħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَبَاحَ (istabāḥa)
# اِسْتَبِحْنَ (istabiḥna) /is.ta.biħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَبَاحَ (istabāḥa)
